scope.note: Private member's bill in committee since June 2024; the extractor's scope_note is fair.

note: Original title 'Yapay Zeka Kanun Teklifi' matches the TBMM page character by character. The 'first AI bill' claim was rightly removed. One search found no change of status for 2/2234 (a tracker still lists it as pending). TR-02 is already related.
translation: Literal rendering of Article 4: 'AI systems with high risk must be registered with the relevant supervisory authorities and be subjected to conformity assessment.' 'Dağıtıcı/Kullanıcı' = 'distributor/user', defined as one who distributes AI systems commercially or uses them in own activities; the record's rendering matches.
